_comment: Which radar and tilt moment each tilt ramp was measured against, and what
the measurement found. Kept apart from coverage.json because the two trees
name moments the same way and mean different fields: a tilt 'velocity' and
a Chivo 'Velocity' fold to one key and paint from different tables over
Produced by validation_tests/visual/ramp_coverage.py over 28 frames per
pair (elevations 1 to 4, frames 0 to 6), copied from the AQPI deployment's
tilt tree at 23:50Z on 2026-11-22. Their radar_plot Time fields, which are
Mountain time, put them at 23:29Z to 23:49Z. 'pixels' is the opaque count
across those frames, and 'colors' is matched over distinct.
The ramps come from build_tilt_ramps.py, which takes the values from the
renderer's plotting call rather than its colorbar. A color match proves the
palette and cannot detect a shift of the scale, so these numbers do not
confirm the range. That rests on the code reading recorded in the ramp files.

pairs.note: Clear air at measurement time, so every painted pixel was the shared #646464 gray. Covered because the same renderer draws all five radars with identical arguments and the other four matched 12 to 17 colors each, not because these frames exercise the table.
